title: Sketch 13. General arrangement, circular
version: The Babbage Papers, Science Museum Group, BAB/A/042, one sheet
lineage: Science Museum Group’s 1536 × 1098 image of Babbage’s original drawing, with the archive item description as a finding aid.

passages.locator: BAB/A/042, left margin, central inscription and upper-right dates
passages.note: The drawing shows rows of perforations at left. The central and upper-right date annotations record work in December 1836 and January 1837 and the introduction of a bevel driving wheel on 18 March 1837.

passages.locator: Archive item title and Made field
passages.note: The archivist identifies a punched-card mechanism in the arrangement and catalogues the sheet under 18 March 1837.
